# Computed reference calls

The six original `.bend` files are unchanged Apache-2.0 fixtures from
[bendlang/bend at e6676b0](https://github.com/bendlang/bend/tree/e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599/tests/flatten).
Original comments and golden normal forms are retained. The 20 application rows
are bounded observations, not an exhaustive input space. New observation and IO
wrappers use MPL-2.0. Constructor projection avoids the separately unresolved
imported-constructor printer issue; it supplies no printed-name parity credit.
